reviews.text: My dog Leeroy gets groomed here. Vlada is fantastic! Quick, professional, and my dog looks and smells wonderful every time. Highly recommend!
My dog isn’t the nicest when it comes to grooming but the team at Dharma has done an amazing job, he’s never looked so good. He left so happy and energized. 10/10 would recommend, no notes.

I am extremely disappointed and upset with this grooming experience. I trusted this groomer with my dog expecting her to be treated with care and, most importantly, to be kept safe. Unfortunately, that is not what happened.

I did not notice the injury immediately after the grooming appointment. It was only the following day that I noticed a bruise underneath her eye, extremely close to her actual eye. The area was clearly not normal, and now my dog is showing signs of pain and discomfort around that area.

What makes me even more upset is that the groomer did not bother to tell us anything whatsoever. Not a single mention that something may have happened. Not a warning to keep an eye on the area. Nothing.
They always do a great job grooming my standard poodle!

Will not be coming back here. Be careful taking ur dogs here. Got my dog back and noticed he was limping outside and when i looked closer he had a half ripped off nail. they didn’t do anything about it until I walked him back and said something.

After the last 5 years of going to dharma I just can’t say enough good things about their service. It’s worth the perhaps additional spend vs a cheap buzz cut … validated by my dog who is happy wagging her tail on the way in for her cut!! Keep up the great work :)

Great staff. Super friendly and my Cat Fendi loves them for doing her nails.

Great prices great location

Unfortunately, I won't be going back even though they provided a refund discount for their miscommunication between intake person and groomer. I gave clear and simple instructions but returned to discover they did not follow them. Perhaps to mitigate this speak directly to your groomer. I still tipped groomer as it wasn't their fault.

First time I went my pup needed a vet visit due to a bump that appeared and persisted after grooming on his back. It was likely a follicle infection. It's never happened at our previous groomer.

Stephanie loves our puppy so much ! And she gives me gentle advise on what to do to keep Millie fresh until her next appointment.
We love Dharma Dog!

my corgi had another great session with Marcus at Dharma Dog! This was our second visit, and i was happy with how clean and neat my corgi is after! his undergarment trim was done great. Will be coming back to Dharma dog for sure!

I would love to brag about this company as they used to do a very good job on my miniature poodle and both of my sisters standard poodles. Unfortunately, my last few visits with them weren’t as positive. Not only has the attention to detail dropped dramatically cut after cut where my poodle ended up looking like a terrier twice the third time the haircut was decent, but her lady parts cut and not only was I not advised, but I was lied about it. We know our dogs my dog was in more distress than usual so I called to ask if anything had happened and they said no when I got home and took a look as she was incisively, licking and saw the cuts called them and they denied anything having happened. I let them know that the cuts were obvious and she’s excessively licking and in pain and was told that the manager would get back to me….No one has. I left a few voice messages but again no one reached out. I get that things happen in appointments but lying about them and trying to cover them up is not the way to keep clients. Not to mention again I got a terrier cut. As of today I still haven’t gotten a call about the incident and it looks like they aren’t interested in my business so moved on. Open to leads or advice on reputable Grooming companies!!
Staff was very accommodating and friendly. No appointment needed for my dogs nail trim

I took my very shy little foster dog here for a nail trim. We were in and out in probably five minutes and they were so good with him. I was worried he was going to have a scary time and need to be muzzled, but they were patient with him and made him (and us) feel more calm. The staff working today were also very lovely, very good experience!
This is such a great place, best groomer in Vancouver!

This is the best place for for dog grooming. Kayla and the staff are amazing. They look after our  Prince . You got a very warm welcome when you walk in and they tell us everything what we need for our baby. Thank you so much Kayla and your staff for a wonderful experience.
Dharma Dog was great - got us in right away and did a great job with our dog, Sadie. Would highly recommend for your dog and so nice to support a local business!
Friendly staff and excellent service.

Used to drive all the way from New West on a recommendation for this groomer. The biggest positive for Dharma Dog is that our dog enjoyed coming here an was always calm and happy when he was dropped off, and seemed to have a great, stress free grooming session the few times we brought him in.
Sadly, the last visit his trim wasn’t done very well and the service wasn’t great.
They had shaved his belly, even though on 2 previous visit we had requested they do not. Perhaps this was our fault for not being clear, but it honestly looked like a rush job to the point where people commented to us how bad his grooming looked.
We can appreciate that an our breed’s double coat poses more of a challenge for groomers to manage with matting etc. Maybe they just ran out of time.
Stood at the counter for about 15 minutes waiting to be helped at pickup after being called. A staff member was sitting outside the front, possibly on break. Nobody was keeping an eye on the front desk. Finally got service after another patron came in and banged on the window for the grooming area.
First visit the trim was great, second was ok, third was pretty sloppy and seemed rushed. Perhaps the last visit was just an extra challenging day for the staff, but was disappointing enough that we chose to not go back.
We have since found a groomer closer to home that seems to be a better fit for the type of breed we have and his more challenging coat. Although the new groomer request that customers books a bit extra time for dematting, they still manage to get done in a few hours, full groom with all the extras for about the same price.
Honest opinion would be to consider other groomers first, there are other options that may be a better fit based on your type of breed.

The only place my dog will let trim her nails.

My dogs ears  were not even clean or trimmed! Yet I felt a lot of water coming out!  Her ears were not even dried off!!! I paid full price  for a full groom! And my sister tipped her! Now I have to take my puppy to the vet cause of her reckless care. She didn’t even tell me my dog was cut until I saw! I am very disappointed as now I will be going to the vet and paying that visit price! The lady who answered the phone said " stephine worked on my dog and I do feel she rushed away this job! My dog only weighs 5pounds!!! This is very ridiculous!!! I hope a manager will be contacting me asap! Thank you

Super lovely little groomer. Kind staff and excellent groomers. Artists!

I’ve tested various dog groomers and this has been the worst experience!
My golden doodle was not matted when I took him in. I asked her NOT to shave him. I was very specific as to how short. I received a call after only one hour and a half when it normally takes 2.5-3 hours for a full groom. When I picked him up I was shocked! They overcharged me and they were cold and completely impersonal. They basically did a rush job so they can quickly get their next customer in. My dog seemed very stressed and not himself.
My sweet dog had knicks and cuts all over his body. When I dropped him off at his daycare they had concerns he may get an infection.
I’m still traumatized from the experience.
I will never go back and do I not recommend this horrible place to anyone.
Our dogs deserve the best care!
Great people excellent work, very highly recommended!!!

I’ve been to a few grooming salons (including my DIY) but wasn’t very impressed with how my dog looked like after. My friend told me about Dharma Dog Services. I booked and requested Kaila. I’d say I’m happy with the results and would highly recommend this place and Kaila!
I’m very happy we’ve found a regular place for dog grooming. Great nail trims for my little dog who HATES nail trims! His groomer Stephanie was very sweet to him and very quick.

Dharma dog is the best place for grooming services! My pup, Michi, has been groomed by Kaila since Sept 2024 and nails it every time. Michi  does have a biting history and I do bring her muzzle each time, but Dharma Dog handles her so well that Michi has grown to love everyone and doesn’t even use her muzzle (even allows them to pet her - big wow!) Definitely bring your pets here!! 🫶🏼
